Vṛttayaḥ pañcatayyaḥ kliṣṭākliṣṭāḥ /I.5/
Vṛttayaḥ pañcatayyaḥ kliṣṭa-akliṣṭāḥ /I.5/

« [Ces] fluctuations sont quinaires
466, pénibles et non pénibles.
467»

Kleśa-hetukāḥ karma-āśaya-pracaye [pracayakṣetrī] kṣetrī-bhūtāḥ kliṣṭāḥ / Khyāti-viṣayā
guṇa-adhikāra-virodhinyo'kliṣṭāḥ / Kliṣṭa-pravāha-patitā apy akliṣṭāḥ
468 / Kliṣṭa-cchidreṣv apy
akliṣṭā bhavanti
469, akliṣṭa-cchidreṣu kliṣṭā iti / Tathā-jātīyakāḥ saṃskārā vṛttibhir eva kriyante
/ Saṃskāraiś ca vṛttaya iti / Evaṃ vṛtti-saṃskāra-cakram aniśam āvartate / Tad evaṃ-bhū
